faq.title: Questions
faq.cancelA: Yes, at any time: open Manage subscription on this page. There is nothing to call or email.
faq.keepQ: What happens to my decks and words if I stop?
faq.keepA: They stay. Your account goes back to the free limits; nothing you made is deleted.
faq.lifetimeA: Yes. You pay once, it never renews, and you keep everything in Pro.
faq.paymentA: Checkout runs on Stripe. FlexiLingo never sees or stores your card number.
faq.fairUseA: For real learning you will never feel a limit. To keep FlexiLingo fast for everyone, automated or scripted use is slowed down and stopped for the day.

meta.title: Community | FlexiLingo
meta.description: Share ideas, vote on features, and help shape the future of FlexiLingo. Join the community discussion.

community.title: Title

howItWorks.title: Your Voice. Real Features.
howItWorks.subtitle: We ship fast. Your ideas don't sit in a backlog — they get built. Here's how it works.

step1.label: Share
step1.title: Drop Your Idea
step1.description: Got a feature request? A way to make learning better? Post it. Our team reviews every single submission — nothing gets ignored.

step2.label: Vote
step2.title: The Community Decides
step2.description: Other learners vote for the ideas they want most. The best ideas naturally rise to the top — no gatekeeping.

step3.label: Review
step3.title: We Prioritize Fast
step3.description: Our engineering team reviews top ideas every sprint. We move quickly — from idea to implementation faster than most teams would.

step4.label: Ship
step4.title: It Goes Live
step4.description: Your idea becomes a real feature. You'll see the status update in real-time — and you'll be one of the first to use what you asked for.

howItWorks.note: Our team ships fast and takes community feedback seriously. This isn't a suggestion box — it's how we build.
